proposals.title: Special Shareholder Meeting Improvement - Proposal 4
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to amend governing documents so owners of a combined 10% of outstanding common stock can call a special shareholder meeting, with equal per-share rights.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends that you vote AGAINST the proposal.

proposals.title: Independent Board Chairman - Proposal 5
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy requiring separation of Chairman and CEO roles, with the Chairman being an independent director who was not a former CEO.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends that you vote AGAINST the proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal on Rule 10b5-1 Plans
proposals.proponent: The Comptroller of the City of New York, as custodian and trustee of the New York City Employees' Retirement System and the New York City Board of Education Retirement System
proposals.topic_summary: Urges a policy on Rule 10b5-1 plans requiring a 120-day cooling-off period, prohibiting overlapping plans, and requiring additional disclosures of plan adoption and trades.
proposals.evidence: The proposal is unnecessarily restrictive and burdensome in light of the pending SEC rules relating to Rule 10b5-1

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal on Lobbying Disclosure
proposals.proponent: The Unitarian Universalist Association and additional proponents
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual report disclosing lobbying policies, payments used for direct, indirect and grassroots lobbying, trade association memberships, and decision-making oversight.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends that you vote AGAINST the proposal.

proposals.title: Antimicrobial Resistance Report (Proposal 8)
proposals.proponent: The Shareholder Commons on behalf of the Jan McMillan Montgomery Generation Skipping Trust
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to commission and publish a report on public health costs of company decisions on antimicrobial resistance, market barriers to investment, and effects on shareholder returns.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends that you vote AGAINST the proposal.
